title: CMPE 491
summary: A university course project (CMPE 491-492) that trains a custom GAN, a CTGAN model, and a Gaussian Copula model to generate synthetic samples resembling a DDoS SDN network-traffic dataset, aiming to augment training data for cybersecurity anomaly-detection models. The project imports the standalone ctgan package (with ctgan.fit() called directly) and SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/Metadata classes from sdv.single_table and sdv.metadata as one of several synthetic-data generators compared.
